source.kind: Codex-owned official session JSONL, scoped read only

stopObservation.interpretation: This is the official turn interruption receipt. It is not proof that the command stopped and is not an exact UI-click or ACP cancel-send timestamp.

screenshots.observation: Reply stopped while a step remains unconfirmed; busy and permission protection remain.

After natural command completion the remaining-step notice clears and permission controls recover.

limits: Only the supplied own acceptance session, records at or after the specified cutoff, and this marker-associated turn/tool were extracted. No unrelated bodies, reasoning or credentials were copied.
The tool start timestamp is the official CommandExecution started_at_ms carried by the completion record; the earlier custom_tool_call timestamp is not substituted for process start.
A custom_tool_call status describes its wrapper call, not actual command completion; the final item_completed CommandExecution is the completion authority.
The command completed after reply interruption with its expected marker and exit 0. This does not prove cancellation stopped the command; it instead confirms a surviving tool tail.
Official process completion and screenshots support their respective layers. No precise UI-click, ACP cancel dispatch or UI-render timestamps are claimed.
Nanosecond reported duration and millisecond timestamp subtraction may differ slightly.
Completion existed on the first scoped read. No polling, new Agent request, source edit, package change or contract edit was performed.
